reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Three's a lot of caffeine stacked right before you train, especially if they're full-strength cans. That much can spike your heart rate and leave you jittery instead of sharp. I'd cap it around one, maybe a second small one if you're dragging, and get the rest of your energy from sleep and food. If your heart's racing or you feel off, that's worth a doctor's ear, not mine."}
